title: The ‘Tall Boy’ 25mm Auto Spinner Set
description:
The ‘Tall Boy’ 25mm Auto Spinner Set
The Tall Boy 25mm auto spinner set is the ideal partner to the Dab-Ready by Old Head TC. But of course can be used in other dab application.
This kit includes a 2
5mm bucket, as well as two 6mm quartz terp pearls, and a 25mm quartz marble.
